pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-quadrilateral dark regions with moderate edge gradients. Geometry is characterized by irregular, jagged boundaries on the flank and smaller, more densely packed shapes transitioning toward the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. The network features high-contrast junctions, primarily trivalent nodes, with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the dorsal neck and shoulder, indicative of a continuous, short-haired mane silhouette.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, localized area of dark, irregular hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible at the transition point between the lower neck and the shoulder.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal-to-irregular dark lesion or marking is present on the lower neck/upper shoulder area, appearing as a significant deviation from the natural pelage pattern.
